Fare/availability grounding: engine + AI values match real GET_FARE / CHECK_AVAILABILITY
fastest = minimum duration among provider candidates
earliest = earliest departure among provider candidates
earliest_arrival = earliest arrival (+day offset) among candidates
cheapest = minimum VERIFIED provider fare among probed candidates (re-verified via GET_FARE)
best_value = deterministic engine pick from provider candidates
preferred_class=CC → deterministic partition: CC-capable trains ranked first, best has CC (search classes ya verified probed class se)
departure window 16:00–20:00 → all candidates inside window
max_fare_inr=700 cap → no candidate above cap (only VERIFIED fares kept; unknown-fare trains dropped with note)
Deterministic + reproducible: identical calls → identical ranking (live snapshot fields may vary, ranking inputs stable)
